compositionRules.assert: Root navigation slot of antd.layout may contain antd.menu; menu does not nest another menu as its own item tree.
Menu is for navigation routing only; never use antd.button inside antd.menu to perform pure navigation.

bad: <Menu items={[{ key: 'inbox', label: 'Inbox' }, { key: 'sent', label: 'Sent' }]} selectedKeys={['inbox']} /> // missing selectedKeys on route change leaves stale highlight
<Button onClick={() => navigate('/inbox')}>Inbox</Button> // using Button for pure navigation instead of Menu
<Menu items={[]} /> // empty items with no fallback leaves dead navigation chrome
<Menu items={[{ key: 'x', label: 'X' }]} selectedKeys={['x']} mode='vertical' /> // mixing vertical mode with inline-selected styling expectations

Profile
// raw nav instead of Menu item with key for selectedKeys tracking
good: <Menu mode='inline' selectedKeys={['inbox']} items={[{ key: 'inbox', label: 'Inbox' }, { key: 'sent', label: 'Sent' }]} />
<Menu mode='horizontal' selectedKeys={['products']} items={[{ key: 'home', label: 'Home' }, { key: 'products', label: 'Products' }]} />
<Menu mode='vertical' selectedKeys={['settings']} items={[{ key: 'profile', label: 'Profile' }, { key: 'settings', label: 'Settings' }]} />

hardRules.message: mode must be one of inline | vertical | horizontal
every key in selectedKeys must match an item key in items
Menu must declare non-empty items; do not render an empty Menu for primary navigation
selected item fill must bind to menu.item.selected token

meaning.definition: Provides persistent navigation structure, indicating the user's current location within an application and offering destinations reachable in one step.
doNotUseWhen: Triggering a one-off action that is not a destination (use Button)
Showing transient status that is not a navigational location (use Alert/Tag)
useWhen: Navigating between top-level or section destinations
Showing current selection/location in a persistent navigation tree
Side or top navigation menus with many peer destinations

contentRules: Each item should carry a unique key
selectedKeys values must match item keys
items.description: Menu item tree; each item has a stable unique key plus label content.

mode.description: Layout orientation axis for the menu (inline | vertical | horizontal).

selectedKeys.description: Keys of currently selected items; drives the active-location highlight.

softRules: Prefer Menu over a row of Buttons when destinations are peers in a navigation context
Bind the menu background to the menu.background token so sidebar/header chrome stays consistent
Use a single canonical mode per placement: inline for sider, horizontal for header, vertical for narrow columns
Keep item labels concise; long labels degrade horizontal menus

semantics.horizontal: Top-level horizontal navigation bar, typically in the header
semantics.inline: Vertical inline menu that expands/collapses submenus inline; used in sider navigation
semantics.vertical: Vertical column of items; submenus pop out
